body: Decision: adopt root vision.md and mission.md at commit 059383e as the co-authored public framing. Narrative Process Alignment is the scientific object; AMR is a local propositional adapter; words, aligned feature tracks, windows, propositions, and narrative hierarchy share an inspectable coordinate system. Runtime goal is unattended processing; epistemic promise is auditable evidence, alternatives, calibration labels, receipts, and sparse portable laws. All 13 red-team findings from claude-storymodel4s were applied, satisfying the stated sign-off condition.
